annotation.bound_parties_text: The representatives of ECOWAS Member States commit themselves to support negotiation of a legally binding instrument on autonomous weapons systems and to pursue regional cooperation.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: We, the representatives of ECOWAS Member States, commit:
annotation.dates_quote: Done in Freetown, Sierra Leone, on 18 April 2024.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: COMMUNIQUÉ OF THE REGIONAL CONFERENCE ON THE PEACE AND SECURITY ASPECTS OF AUTONOMOUS WEAPONS SYSTEMS: AN ECOWAS PERSPECTIVE
